meta.name: hyperframes-registry
meta.description: Install, discover, and wire registry blocks and components into HyperFrames compositions. Use when running hyperframes add or hyperframes catalog, installing one item or every block matching a tag, wiring an installed item into index.html, or working with hyperframes.json. Covers discovery, install locations, block sub-composition wiring, component snippet merging, and authoring a new block or component to contribute upstream (idea → scaffold → validate → PR).

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能执行 hyperframes 命令行：按名称或标签安装块/组件、查询目录、把安装结果接进宿主页面并补全属性，还能在目录无结果时生成反馈报告，并按模板新建组件。
howto.when: 当你提出要安装或查找 hyperframes 组件、把组件接进页面、处理 hyperframes.json，或想新建组件贡献上游时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 hyperframes add 安装 data-chart 块。
say.note: Claude 会安装该块并给出接线片段。

say.text: 搜索能逐行显示标题的组件。
把 grain-overlay 组件接进 index.html。
say.note: Claude 会复制组件代码并提示接线属性。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can run hyperframes CLI commands: install blocks/components by name or tag, query the catalog, wire installed items into a host page with required attributes, report catalog search misses, and scaffold new components for upstream contributions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to install or find hyperframes blocks/components, wire them into a page, work with hyperframes.json, or create a new component to contribute upstream.

say_en.text: Install the data-chart block with hyperframes add.
say_en.note: Claude installs it and prints a wiring snippet.

say_en.text: Search for a component that reveals a headline line by line.
say_en.note: Claude runs catalog --query against the registry.

say_en.text: Wire the grain-overlay component into index.html.
say_en.note: Claude copies the snippet and notes required attributes.
